steps.name: remove-legacy-file-blog-loader
steps.summary: Re-check import and transition consumers, then remove the test-only file-based blog loader if the DB-backed public source is the only live runtime.

steps.name: shrink-post-publish-verification-contract
steps.summary: Keep the crawler manifest used by public outputs and remove only the verification, job-creation, and failure-decision contracts with no live caller.

steps.name: shrink-diagram-asset-contract
steps.summary: Keep the render-time diagram asset integrity predicate and remove only unwired planning, storage, failure, and audit helpers.

steps.name: shrink-admin-contract
steps.summary: Keep the PostgreSQL-backed retract and admin audit boundary and remove preview, draft, publish, correction, unpublish, and operational actions that have no live repository or route caller.

steps.name: remove-test-only-model-mirrors
steps.summary: Remove the stale table-name registry and unwired generation-run record factory while preserving live domain types, migrations, validation, persistence, and usage records.

steps.name: remove-test-only-public-data-fixture
steps.summary: Replace the sole test import with existing test store builders, then delete the 200-line public-data fixture that has no runtime caller.

steps.name: remove-test-only-repository-write-apis
steps.summary: Remove repository write methods used only as integration-test setup while preserving aggregate persistence, internal publish-job insertion, idempotency, and rollback verification coverage.

steps.name: remove-redundant-blog-slug-proxy
steps.summary: Remove the extra proxy-level published-slug lookup and let the DB-backed blog detail page own its existing not-found boundary while retaining the Markdown rewrite.

steps.name: prune-unused-worker-capabilities
steps.summary: Remove the unconsumed worker-mode setting and unused worker egress network without changing scheduler egress, database, Nginx, privacy, or cost boundaries.

steps.name: deduplicate-container-runtime-defaults
steps.summary: Use Docker image CMD and ENV as the single runtime defaults and remove identical Compose and systemd overrides while retaining the OAuth preflight.
